### Walk in Love
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/walk-love
Passage: 2 John 6
Points:
- Intellectual and doctrinal knowledge must never replace the essential Christian call to love.
- Even faithful believers walking in biblical truth constantly need reminders to love others.
- Biblical love is not mere sentimental emotion, but active obedience to God's commandments.
- Walking in love means putting faith into practice through concrete deeds toward our neighbors.
